lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of approximately six horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill region, showing a consistent inter-blob distance in the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a distinctive grid pattern across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and a sharp shadow gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of high-luminance spots arranged in approximately three vertical columns, with increased pixel blurring towards the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple smaller fish silhouettes (remoras) located ventrally and beneath the primary pectoral fin.
